# alexlarner/PowerShell-Learning-Path

Summary (expert):
- Purpose: Curated learning path and reference links for PowerShell from beginner to advanced topics (tools, syllabus, recommended books and modules).
- Why it matters: Good foundational resource for team members who need PowerShell proficiency to understand or extend PowerShell-based agents and tooling.

Relevance to our project:
- Medium. Not agentic itself but valuable as onboarding and skill-building material for contributors who will work on PowerShell-based integrations or build PowerShell connectors for our agents.

Recommended integration steps:
1. Add key syllabus and recommended modules to `reference-repositories/third_party/PowerShell-Learning-Path/HIGHLIGHTS.md` (extract useful modules like `PSFramework`, `ImportExcel`, `platyPS`).
2. Link to specific sections from our `LEARNING_SUMMARY.md` for team onboarding.
3. Use the Learning Path as a reference when documenting PowerShell-based agent adapters (e.g., how to wrap `AIPSTeam.ps1` as a callable tool).

Local path: reference-repositories/third_party/PowerShell-Learning-Path
